## Chinook Input_csv function test
```{r}

format_qPCR_data_chinook <- function(input_csv){  
   require(tidyverse)

  qPCRdata <- read.csv(input_csv)
       
              qPCRdata <- qPCRdata %>% 
                mutate(Task=ifelse(str_detect(Sample,"standard"), "STANDARD", "UNKNOWN"),
                       Task=ifelse(str_detect(Sample,"Coho"), "UNKNOWN", Task),
                       Task=ifelse(str_detect(Sample,"Eulachon"), "UNKNOWN", Task)) %>% 
                mutate(z = ifelse(is.na(Ct), 0, 1),
                       Ct = ifelse(is.na(Ct), 99, Ct)) %>% 
                mutate(Ct = as.numeric(Ct),
                       Ct = round(Ct, 2)) %>%  #do away with ridiculous decimal places 
                mutate(conc = NA) %>% 
                mutate(Quantity = 0) %>% 
                mutate(., Quantity = case_when(Sample == "Chinook_E05_standard" ~ 100000,
                                               Sample == "Chinook_E04_standard" ~ 10000,
                                               Sample == "Chinook_E03_standard" ~ 1000,
                                               Sample == "Chinook_E02_standard" ~ 100,
                                               Sample == "Chinook_E01_standard" ~ 10,
                                               Sample == "Chinook_E.7_standard" ~ 5,
                                               Sample == "Chinook_E0_standard" ~ 1,
                                               Sample == "Combo_E05_standard" ~ 100000,
                                               Sample == "Combo_E04_standard" ~ 10000,
                                               Sample == "Combo_E03_standard" ~ 1000,
                                               Sample == "Combo_E02_standard" ~ 100,
                                               Sample == "Combo_E01_standard" ~ 10,
                                               Sample == "Combo_E.7_standard" ~ 5,
                                               Sample == "Combo_E0_standard" ~ 1,
                                               TRUE ~ Quantity)) %>% 
                mutate(PlateName = Plate) %>% #retain original plate name
                mutate(Plate = match(Plate, unique(Plate))) #index plates sequentially
              
         qPCRdata %>% 
           mutate(., Sample = case_when(Task == "STANDARD"~as.character(Quantity),
                                        TRUE ~Sample),
                  conc = case_when(Task == "STANDARD"~as.numeric(Quantity),
                                        TRUE ~conc))-> qPCRdata
              
              qPCRdata <- qPCRdata %>% 
                unite(c(Plate,Sample), col = "plateSample", remove = F) %>% 
                mutate(plateSample_idx = match(plateSample, unique(plateSample))) %>% 
                group_by(plateSample) %>% 
                add_tally(Ct == 99) %>% 
                filter(n < 3) %>% #do away with examples of three non-detections; we have no basis for modeling these. 
                dplyr::select(-n) %>% 
                mutate(plateSample_idx = match(plateSample, unique(plateSample))) #reindex
              
              #QC filter
              qPCRdata <- qPCRdata %>%
                group_by(Plate, plateSample) %>% 
                mutate(sdCt = sd(Ct)) %>% 
               filter(sdCt < 1.5 | sdCt > 20) %>% #really bad triplicates; don't throw out instances where 1 or 2 out of 3 was a detection (which, because Ct = 99 for nondetect, inflates the sd)
                ungroup() %>% 
                mutate(plateSample_idx = match(plateSample, unique(plateSample))) #reindex
               return(qPCRdata)
}
```

#format_qPCR_data_beluga
```{r}

format_qPCR_data_beluga <- function(input_csv){  
   require(tidyverse)

    qPCRdata <- read.csv(input_csv)
              qPCRdata <- qPCRdata %>% 
                mutate(Task=ifelse(str_detect(Sample,"standard"), "STANDARD", "UNKNOWN")) %>% 
                mutate(z = ifelse(is.na(Ct), 0, 1),
                       Ct = ifelse(is.na(Ct), 99, Ct),
                       Ct = ifelse(Ct > 40, 99, Ct)) %>% 
                mutate(Ct = as.numeric(Ct),
                       Ct = round(Ct, 2)) %>%  #do away with ridiculous decimal places 
                mutate(conc = NA) %>% 
                mutate(Quantity = 0) %>% 
                mutate(., Quantity = case_when(Sample == "Beluga_E05_standard" ~ 100000,
                                               Sample == "Beluga_E04_standard" ~ 10000,
                                               Sample == "Beluga_E03_standard" ~ 1000,
                                               Sample == "Beluga_E02_standard" ~ 100,
                                               Sample == "Beluga_E01_standard" ~ 10,
                                               Sample == "Beluga_E.7_standard" ~ 5,
                                               Sample == "Beluga_E0_standard" ~ 1,
                                               TRUE ~ Quantity)) %>% 
                mutate(PlateName = Plate) %>% #retain original plate name
                mutate(Plate = match(Plate, unique(Plate))) #index plates sequentially
              
         qPCRdata %>% 
           mutate(., Sample = case_when(Task == "STANDARD"~as.character(Quantity),
                                        TRUE ~Sample),
                  conc = case_when(Task == "STANDARD"~as.numeric(Quantity),
                                        TRUE ~conc))-> qPCRdata
              
              qPCRdata <- qPCRdata %>% 
                unite(c(Plate,Sample), col = "plateSample", remove = F) %>% 
                mutate(plateSample_idx = match(plateSample, unique(plateSample))) %>% 
                group_by(plateSample) %>% 
                add_tally(Ct == 99) %>% 
                filter(n < 3) %>% #do away with examples of three non-detections; we have no basis for modeling these. 
                dplyr::select(-n) %>% 
                mutate(plateSample_idx = match(plateSample, unique(plateSample))) #reindex
              
              #QC filter
              qPCRdata <- qPCRdata %>%
                group_by(Plate, plateSample) %>% 
            mutate(, detections = case_when(Ct < 99 ~ 1,
                                  TRUE ~ 0),
         num_detections = sum(detections)) %>% 
                mutate(sdCt = sd(Ct), 
                       meanCt=mean(Ct)) %>% 
                filter(sdCt < 1.5 | sdCt > 20 ) %>% #really bad triplicates; don't throw out instances where 1 or 2 out of 3 was a detection (which, because Ct = 99 for nondetect, inflates the sd), below these are one off samples with very low Ct and only 1 replicate
                mutate(., to_drop =case_when(num_detections < 3 & meanCt >70 & Ct <35~ "drop",
                       TRUE ~"keep")) %>%
                filter(., to_drop!="drop") %>% 
                ungroup() %>% 
                group_by(plateSample) %>% 
                mutate(meanCt2=mean(Ct)) %>%  
                filter(., meanCt2 !=99) %>% #do away with examples of three non-detections; we have no basis for modeling these. 
                                ungroup() %>% 
                mutate(plateSample_idx = match(plateSample, unique(plateSample))) #reindex
               return(qPCRdata)
}

```

```{r}

prepare_stan_data_qPCR <- function(qPCRdataname){
        
        require(tidyverse)
        qPCRdata_beluga -> qPCRdataname
        qPCRdata <- qPCRdataname
        
        type <- qPCRdata %>% dplyr::select(plateSample, Task) %>% distinct() %>% pull(Task)
        
        stan_qPCR_data <- list(
          Nplates = length(unique(qPCRdata$Plate)),
          Nobs = nrow(qPCRdata),
          NSamples = length(unique(qPCRdata$plateSample)),
          NstdSamples = qPCRdata %>% filter(Task == "STANDARD") %>% dplyr::select(plateSample) %>% distinct() %>% nrow(),
          plate_idx = qPCRdata$Plate, 
          std_idx =  which(type=="STANDARD"),
          unkn_idx = which(type != "STANDARD"),
          plateSample_idx = qPCRdata$plateSample_idx, 
          y = qPCRdata$Ct,
          z = qPCRdata$z,
          known_concentration = qPCRdata %>% filter(Task == "STANDARD") %>% dplyr::select(plateSample_idx, conc) %>% distinct() %>% pull(conc),
          stdCurvePrior_intercept = c(39, 3), #normal distr, mean and sd ; hyperpriors
          stdCurvePrior_slope = c(-3, 1) #normal distr, mean and sd ; hyperpriors
        )


        return(stan_qPCR_data)
        
}
```

```{r}
calibrate_qPCR <- function(stanmodelname, dataname, NCHAINS = 10, WARMUP = 500, ITER = 5000){
        #actual calibration in stan
        #input = named list
        #output = posterior samples for many params
        #dependencies = listed packages
        
        require(tidyverse)
        require(rstan)
        rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
        options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
        
        qMod = stan(file = stanmodelname, data = dataname,
                    verbose = FALSE, chains = NCHAINS, thin = 1,
                    warmup = WARMUP, iter = ITER,
                    control = list(adapt_init_buffer = 175,
                                   max_treedepth=18,
                                   stepsize=0.01,
                                   adapt_delta=.95,
                                   metric="diag_e"),
                    refresh = 10,
                    boost_lib = NULL
        )
        
        return(qMod)
        
}
      
stanmodelname  <-  here("data","qPCR_results","code","qPCR_calibration_enchilada.stan")
calibrate_qPCR(stanmodelname,stan_qPCR_data_chinook) -> qMod_chinook
calibrate_qPCR(stanmodelname,stan_qPCR_data_coho) -> qMod_coho
calibrate_qPCR(stanmodelname,stan_qPCR_data_beluga) -> qMod_beluga
calibrate_qPCR(stanmodelname,stan_qPCR_data_eulachon) -> qMod_eulachon


check_hmc_diagnostics(qMod_chinook)
check_hmc_diagnostics(qMod_coho)
check_hmc_diagnostics(qMod_beluga)
check_hmc_diagnostics(qMod_eulachon)

saveRDS(qMod_eulachon, file=here("analysis","qMod_eulachon.RDS"))
save(qMod_eulachon, file=here("analysis","qMod_eulachon.RData"))

saveRDS(qMod_coho, file=here("analysis","qMod_coho.RDS"))
save(qMod_coho, file=here("analysis","qMod_coho.RData"))

saveRDS(qMod_beluga, file=here("analysis","qMod_beluga.RDS"))
save(qMod_beluga, file=here("analysis","qMod_beluga.RData"))
saveRDS(qMod_chinook, file=here("analysis","qMod_chinook.RDS"))
save(qMod_chinook, file=here("analysis","qMod_chinook.RData"))

qMod_beluga2 <- load(file=here("analysis","qMod_beluga.RData"))
```

## Tidy chinook

```{r}

tidy_summary_chinook <- as.data.frame(qMod_chinook) %>%
  # Reshape data to long format, keeping only the parameter name and its value
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "draws") %>%
  # Group by parameter to perform calculations for each parameter
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  # Summarize to compute the mean and credible intervals
  summarise(
    # Posterior mean
    mean = mean(draws),
    # 95% credible interval (equal-tailed)
    q2.5 = quantile(draws, 0.025),
    q97.5 = quantile(draws, 0.975),
    q25 = quantile(draws, 0.25),
    q75 = quantile(draws, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop" # Drop grouping for final output
  )

tidy_summary_chinook %>% 
  filter(., str_detect(parameter,"envir_concentration")) %>% 
    mutate(., order_idx = str_remove(parameter, "envir_concentration\\["),
          order_idx = as.integer(str_remove(order_idx, "\\]"))) %>% 
  left_join(namers_sample_chinook) %>% 
  mutate(., `Target Name` = "Chinook") -> qMod_chinook_tibble

saveRDS(qMod_chinook_tibble, file=here("analysis","qMod_chinook_tibble.RDS"))
```
